## Summary

Write this section and the next two with the `pr` skill. Lead with the outcome in a line or two, then the smallest diagram, call tree or diff sketch that shows the change.

## Evidence

What you ran and what you saw, before and after, with counts.

## Before / after

Only when the change touches what a person sees: the annotated image from `verify-airdesign before-after` and its `| main | this PR |` table, or the one line `No visible change: <why>`.

## Merge Danger

The door, one-way or two-way, and the blast radius in a word, each with a short reason.

## Not done

Faults you pinned and follow-ups. Leave out a section that does not apply.
